name: cheap-ny-publication
description: New York LLC publication deadlines, prices and filings, from the state's live register.

interface.longDescription:
Every new New York LLC must publish a notice in two newspapers for six weeks and file proof with the state within 120 days. Cheap NY Publication handles it for one all-in price, and this app answers the questions people ask before they start.

Name any New York LLC and the app reads the state's live business register (Department of State data on data.ny.gov) to show its county on file, its 120-day publication deadline and how many days are left, the month its next Biennial Statement is due, and the exact price to publish it. Ask what publication costs in a county, whether a new LLC name is free, what forming one or several LLCs costs with an EIN or a DBA, or what a Biennial Statement, Certificate of Good Standing, DBA or county change costs. It also explains the rules (LLC Law §206 and §802) and what happens if the deadline is missed.

Every price comes from the same tables as our checkout. The app never places an order: when you want to go ahead, it gives you a link to our checkout, where you see the full price before paying. Cheap NY Publication is a private filing service, not a law firm, and not affiliated with the New York Department of State.
capabilities: Look up any New York LLC on the state register by name or DOS ID
Show an LLC's 120-day publication deadline and days left
Price LLC publication for any of New York's 62 counties
Check whether a new LLC or PLLC name is available
Quote forming one or several LLCs with publication, EIN and DBA
Price Biennial Statements, Certificates of Good Standing, DBAs and county changes
Explain New York's publication requirement and missed deadlines
Report monthly New York LLC formation statistics
defaultPrompt: When is the publication deadline for Redstone Castle LLC in New York?
How much does LLC publication cost in Brooklyn?
What would it cost to form 3 New York LLCs, one per rental property, with EINs?
